topic_zh: 功能需求和非功能需求：先问清楚再画图
topic_en: Functional vs non-functional requirements: ask before you draw

xhs.title: 系统设计面试，第一步不是画图
xhs.body:
系统设计第 2 课：先问清需求再画图
功能需求 = 系统要做什么（短链接：生成短链、点开跳转）
非功能需求 = 做得多好：多快、多稳、多大
这些答案决定架构：点击远多于创建就加缓存，不能挂就多放几台服务器，但每加一块都有成本
考考你：「用户可以给短链接设置过期时间」是功能需求还是非功能需求？评论区告诉我～

douyin.title: 系统设计第一步：分清功能需求和非功能需求
douyin.body:

tiktok.body: System design interviews: don't draw yet. Ask what it does, then how well. Quick quiz: "Users can set an expiry time on a short link." Functional or non-functional? Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: In a system design interview, step one isn't the diagram
linkedin.body:
Functional requirements: what the system does. For a URL shortener, create a short link and redirect to the original.
Non-functional requirements: how well. How fast, how reliable, how big.
The answers shape the design: far more reads than writes suggests a cache; must stay up means several servers. Every box you add has a cost.
Quick quiz: "Users can set an expiry time on a short link." Functional or non-functional? Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: 「用户可以给短链接设置过期时间」是功能需求还是非功能需求？
quiz.q_en: "Users can set an expiry time on a short link." Functional or non-functional?
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：A，功能需求。它说的是用户能做什么（一个功能），不是多快、多稳、多大。
quiz.answer_en: Answer: A, functional. It describes something users can do (a feature), not how fast, reliable or big the system is.
